blocks.text: Introduction: Our God is the Almighty one and His knowledge of us can be likened to that of a manufacturer of an engine who knows all intricacies of the engine. As the Chief Architect of our nature and/or the manufacturer of all parts of our body, ({{ps 139:13,ps 139:14,ps 139:15,ps 139:16|Ps 139:13-16}}) He knows what to do to any part that falls out of harmony at any point in time. He wants toheal us, we only limit His power if we deny His healing power today. We need His healing touch today more than as obtained during Christ's like ministry and the apostolic age. {{ps 103:3,ps 103:4|Psalms 103:3-4}} says... who healeth ALL thy Diseases...

items: The original state of man The Bible in {{ps 139:14|Psalms 139:14}} says we are fearfully and wonderfully made. God looked and considered the work He has just created and certified and pronounced that, "it was very good" ({{gn 1:31|Gen. 1:31}}). God originally created man perfect; no ailment, no disability, no disease and no sickness. In His own perfect image created He man ({{gn 1:27|Gen. 1:27}})

blocks.text: The maxim that there is "no curse without cause" is very relevant to our point of consideration here since there is as well no sickness without source. Some sources of illnesses are:

1. Sin: Man was tempted, sinned and fell in the Garden of Eden {{gn 3:1,gn 3:2,gn 3:3,gn 3:4,gn 3:5,gn 3:6|Gen. 3:1-6}}; since God could no longer dwell in man because of indwelling sin, the original state of perfection was lost {{ps 139:16|Ps 139:16}}. The presence of sin in man implies the presence of the devil and his works and that means problems, woes, sickness, afflictions, etc. since he, the devil, is the author of them all and there is nothing good in him. {{job 1:8,job 1:9,job 1:10,job 1:11,job 1:12,job 1:13,job 1:14,job 1:15,job 1:16,job 1:17,job 1:18,job 1:19,job 1:20,job 1:21,job 1:22|Job 1:8-22}}; 2:6-10; Jn. 10:10; {{lk 13:14,lk 13:15,lk 13:16,lk 13:17|Lk. 13:14-17}}. Is God aware of this? Certainly Yes. {{ps 139:16|Ps 139:16}}; and He made provision for our restoration and set in motion from the beginning the process of our regaining perfection by dealing and destroying the root cause of our fall. I Jn 3:8; {{cl 1:27,cl 1:28|Col 1:27-28}};{{eph 4:11,eph 4:12,eph 4:13|Eph 4:11-13}} 2. Malnutrition: Poor health due to inadequate intake of balanced diet. 3. Over-eating: Overworking the systems of the body will break them down {{prv 23:21|Prov. 23:21}}. Here, overeating (gluttony) is likened to drunkenness. Also, overeating of certain types of food could cause illness for instance intake of excess fat and vitamins have been associated with some diseases. God forbade his people from eating fat and blood Lev.7:25 4. Curses and demonic attack: {{lk 13:16|Luke 13:16}}; {{act 13:9,act 13:10,act 13:11|Acts 13:9-11}} 5. Other sources can be through overwork, sleeplessness, restlessness, over-anxiety and worries. {{prv 17:22,prv 15:13|Prov. 17:22, 15:13}}.

Our Lord Jesus Christ died and rose again to guarantee us perfect redemption. Part of the tredemption package is our good health and power over sickness and disease III John 2; Is. 53:4-5; {{mt 8:17|Matt. 8:17}}; I Pet. 2:24; {{lk 9:1,lk 9:2|Lk 9:1-2}}. By redemption, we have been berought back to our former position. However, because we lost that position to Satan, he is not going to let go easily unless we send him packing by violence! ({{mt 11:12|Matt 11:12}}).

1. Prayer by the sick person {{jm 5:13,jm 5:16|James 5:13, 16}}; Jn 14:13-14; {{ph 2:9,ph 2:10,ph 2:11|Phil 2:9-11}}. Nothing hinders the devil from trying you with a sickness and nothing stops you from rejecting his offer and dispatching it back to him with the speed of the Spirit of the Lord and the name Jesus. When you are ill, check your life for sin. Confess and repent of it if there is sin, and thereafter pray a prayer of healing for yourself and the result will amaze you if you do all things by faith. {{2kgs 20:3,2kgs 20:4,2kgs 20:5|II Kings 20:3-5}}

2. By united or communal prayer of two or more brethren. {{mt 18:19|Matt 18:19}}; {{jm 5:16|James 5:16}}. This is why you need to belong to a Church near you. 3. By laying hands on the sick person. Mark 16;17-18; {{act 9:17,act 9:18|Acts 9:17-18}}; {{act 28:8,act 28:9|Acts 28:8-9}}. This must be done with caution. Ensure you have consecrated your life and you are living holy before laying hands on the sick. II Cor 8:5; {{rm 12:1|Rom 12:1}}; 6:13. 4. Anointing the sick with oil and prayer of faith by elders (in the faigh of the church). {{jm 5:14,jm 5:15|James 5:14-15}}, There should be no unscriptural ceremonies like ritual washing, burning candles, holy water, putting on of cross, etc. The Bible says the preayer of faith and nothing else. {{mk 5:25,mk 5:26,mk 5:27,mk 5:28,mk 5:29|Mark 5:25-29}}.
D. How to keep your healing and remain healthy

items: You must be born again Jn. 3:3-7; 16, 36. Note that healing is the children's bread
After salvation, you must live in obedience. Touch no sin anymore. {{dt 7:12,dt 7:15|Deut. 7:12, 15}}; Is. 1:18-20; Jn 5:14; {{jm 4:7|James 4:7}}.
Worship God continually in spirit and in truth. Jn. 4:24.
When Satan tries you with illness, confess what the word of God says about your healing and claim the promises. Confess strength at all times and not weakness. I Cor 3:16-17; {{jl 3:10|Joel 3:10}}.

conclusion.text: The realm at which divine healing is operated is the realm of dominion. God wants to take you there. To seek refuge at the doctors pharmacy at every appearance of illness is not sinful but indicates you are still far from where God wants you to be. Develop strong faith against sickness today based on the Word of God and you will in no time find yourself walking in the real of dominion. Call upon God first when any form of illness strikes because He is the Great Doctor. If nothing else, ask that He grants the Doctors wisdom and insight to help you, so that they would not misdiagnose your illness nor threat you with the wrong medicine or dosage. God works through them because he created the profession. He also directs and teaches them.
